name: 8. No longer holds old passport
opening_message: i dont have my old passport anymore, need a new one
opening_reply:
Since your old passport is gone, this will be treated as a **lost passport** case (a special category of renewal), and there are some extra requirements beyond a normal renewal:

1. **Police complaint** – you must submit the original of the police complaint about the loss, which should include your lost passport number. If you don't have the old passport number, you can obtain it from the Colombo Head Office or a Regional Office.
2. **If lost abroad** – you'll also need the temporary travel document (NMRP) you used to re-enter Sri Lanka, plus a photocopy of it.
3. **Fine (in addition to the normal passport fee)**:
   - If the passport was lost within one year of issue: **Rs. 20,000** fine.
   - If lost after one year of issue: **Rs. 15,000** fine (only charged if the passport's validity period hadn't already lapsed).

To finish processing your specific case (fee, exact document checklist, and accepting office), I still need one more piece of information: **your age** (or the applicant's age), since fees differ for applicants under 16. Could you provide that so I can pull the exact fee and finalize your case?

name: 11. Under-16 applicant returns the scope gate
opening_message: need a passport for my child, she's 10
opening_reply: GovAssist does not yet support passport applications for applicants under 16. Under-16 applications have their own document set, consent requirements, and fee structure (validity-period dependent: LKR 3,000/9,000 for 3-year validity, LKR 10,000/20,000 for 10-year) that this build does not yet encode. Please contact the Department of Immigration and Emigration directly for a minor's application.

name: 12. Exactly 16 — fingerprint requirement's lower boundary
opening_message: im 16 renewing my passport, do i need fingerprints
opening_reply:
Per Department of Immigration & Emigration rules, fingerprints are mandatory for every applicant who is above 16 years of age and below 60 years of age (this was introduced under the Immigration and Emigration Act No. 20 of 1948 as amended by Act No. 7 of 2015). Fingerprints are only captured at the Head Office or Regional Offices, and you must appear in person for this.

Since the rule's threshold is "above 16," a 16-year-old applicant is right at the boundary. If you are still exactly 16 (not yet older than 16), the fingerprint requirement technically does not yet apply to you; once you turn older than 16, it will. Given how close you are to this threshold, it's a good idea to confirm your exact status with the passport office when you submit your renewal application, since they apply this rule based on your age at the time of application.
